en: A sepia-toned image showing a stone chamber or building interior, featuring finely cut and fitted stones characteristic of ancient masonry. The structure includes three rectangular niches or windows in the central wall, framed by larger, well-shaped stones at the base and rougher stones at the top. The style is distinctly reminiscent of Incan architecture, known for its precise stonework.
